name: Stormbringer: Improved Forked Lightning and Electric Energy work natively (#1675, #3371)
contract: #1675: Improved Forked Lightning (300597) is a flat SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS (17) of +1, class mask (256,0,0), which matches only Forked Lightning's own SpellFamilyFlags (256,0,32); Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets reads EffectChainTarget[0] (4 in the DBC) and applies the mod through the generic spell-mod path, with no family-22 override in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, so 4 becomes 5 on every rank including the top rank 582304. Call Lightning (500040, flags (0,16,32)) is outside the mask and stays at 4, proving the restriction. #3371: Electric Energy (804278) is a flat SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (0) PCT modifier, EffectBasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20%, class mask (2048,18,0) matching exactly Shock (503326, flags (2048,0,0)), Call Lightning (500040, flags (0,16,32)) and Arm of Thorim (501433, flags (0,2,32)); Forked Lightning (501438, flags (256,0,32)) is outside the mask and is the negative control for this half. Both modifiers are read with spell_modifier, which applies the player's real spell mods on top of the DBC base value (apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md). Arm of Thorim is not a clean 1000 baseline: every Stormbringer permanently carries 887004 'CoA Aura - Stormbringer Class' (AscensionClassTuning::Synchronize applies it class-wide, independent of spec or talents), whose own Effect[2] is an ADD_PCT_MODIFIER on op 0 with class mask (0,2,0) - the same dword1 bit as Arm of Thorim and only Arm of Thorim among this scenario's probes (Shock/Call Lightning/Forked Lightning masks do not overlap it). Its EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = +10% always applies first, so Arm of Thorim's op-0 baseline is 1100, and Electric Energy's own +20% then compounds multiplicatively (Player::ApplySpellMod multiplies per-mod factors for SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) to 1000*1.10*1.20 = 1320, not 1200.
